name: WP Top News — Build a Complete News Portal in WordPress
author: Hossni Mubarak

sections.description:
WP Top News is a flexible WordPress news plugin that helps you create, organize and display news articles in beautiful, responsive layouts.

Create your own news directly from your WordPress dashboard and display it anywhere on your website using simple shortcodes.

Whether you are building a news portal, online magazine, newspaper website, blog, organization website or a dedicated news section, WP Top News gives you multiple ways to present your content.

With the free version, you can start with clean Grid and List layouts.

Upgrade to Pro to unlock advanced layouts including Editorial Grid, Modern List, Breaking News Ticker, Homepage Hero, Featured News Slider and RSS Feed Display.

View Live Demo

📰 Multiple News Layouts

WP Top News gives you multiple professional ways to present your news content.

Free layouts:

  • Basic Grid
  • Basic List

Pro layouts:

  • Editorial Grid – magazine-style editorial layout
  • Modern List – clean horizontal news layout
  • Breaking News Ticker – multiple ticker styles
  • Homepage Hero – highlight important stories on your homepage
  • Featured News Slider – showcase selected news in a responsive slider
  • RSS Feed Display – display RSS content using ticker and widget options

View Live Demo

✨ Create Your Own News

Create and manage your news directly from the WordPress dashboard.

You can:

  • Create unlimited news items
  • Organize news with categories
  • Display news by category
  • Activate or deactivate news items
  • Control the number of news displayed
  • Choose how news is ordered
  • Control grid columns
  • Show or hide descriptions
  • Enable pagination
  • Open news details in the same or new tab
  • Support RTL layouts

🎨 Beautiful News Layouts

Choose the layout that fits your website and content.

Free

Basic Grid

Display your news in a clean and responsive grid layout.

Control the number of columns and other display options using the plugin settings or shortcode.

Basic List

Display your news in a simple and readable list layout with featured images, titles and descriptions.

Pro

Editorial Grid

Create a magazine-style editorial layout with large featured images, categories, titles and descriptions.

Modern List

Display news in a clean modern horizontal layout with large images and article information.

Breaking News Ticker

Highlight important stories using multiple ticker styles:

  • Marquee
  • Horizontal
  • Typewriter
  • Vertical

Customize ticker labels, icons, speed and styling.

Homepage Hero

Create a prominent hero news section for your homepage and highlight important stories.

Featured News Slider

Display selected or featured news using a responsive slider carousel.

RSS Feed Display

Display RSS feed content using ticker and widget-related options.

Upgrade to WP Top News Pro

⚡ Powerful Shortcodes

WP Top News includes shortcode options that give you control over how your news is displayed.

Display news in a grid:

[wtn_news layout=”grid”]

Display news in a list:

[wtn_news layout=”list”]

Display news from a category:

[wtn_news layout=”list” category=”sports”]

Hide descriptions:

[wtn_news layout=”list” description=”hide”]

Control grid columns:

[wtn_news layout=”grid” column=”2″]

You can combine shortcode options to create different news sections throughout your website.

📱 Responsive Design

WP Top News layouts are designed to work across desktop, tablet and mobile devices.

🌍 RTL Support

WP Top News includes RTL support for websites using right-to-left languages.

🌐 Translation Ready

WP Top News is translation-ready and includes a POT file for localization.

💎 WP Top News Pro

Take your news website further with WP Top News Pro.

Pro features include:

  • Editorial Grid layout
  • Modern List layout
  • Breaking News Ticker
  • Homepage Hero section
  • Featured News Slider
  • RSS Feed Display
  • Advanced shortcode options
  • Layout customization
  • Ticker customization and styling
  • Multiple ticker styles
  • Ticker speed controls
  • Ticker icon customization
  • Additional display options

View Pro Features

Upgrade to Pro

🚀 Why WP Top News?

  • Build a complete news portal in WordPress
  • Create and manage your own news
  • Multiple professional news layouts
  • Free Grid and List layouts
  • Advanced Pro layouts
  • Breaking news ticker styles
  • Homepage hero section
  • Featured news slider
  • RSS feed display
  • Category-based news display
  • Powerful shortcode options
  • Responsive design
  • RTL support
  • No coding required

External Services

WP Top News allows you to optionally display content from RSS feeds when the RSS Feed Display feature is used.

When an RSS feed URL is configured, your website may connect to the external RSS feed provider to retrieve feed content.

The availability, accuracy and content of an external RSS feed are controlled by the respective RSS feed provider.

Please make sure you have permission to use content from any external RSS feed.

WP Top News also uses Freemius for optional plugin licensing, account management, premium upgrades and related services.

Freemius may process information required for licensing, updates, purchases and account management when you interact with Freemius-powered features.

For more information, please see the Freemius privacy information:
https://freemius.com/privacy/data-practices/

Support

Need help?

Visit the WordPress.org support forum or contact us through our website.

We are happy to help with bugs, questions and suggestions.
sections.installation:
Install WP Top News as a regular WordPress plugin. Here are different ways to install plugin:

Install by search plugin:

  1. In your WordPress admin dashboard, go to Plugins > Add New.
  2. Search for “WP Top News”.
  3. Click Install Now.
  4. Activate the plugin.
  5. Go to the WP Top News menu in your WordPress dashboard.
  6. Create your news items.
  7. Configure your preferred layout.
  8. Copy the generated shortcode.
  9. Add the shortcode to any page or post.

You can also install WP Top News manually:

  1. Download the WP Top News ZIP file.
  2. Go to Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin.
  3. Upload the ZIP file.
  4. Click Install Now.
  5. Activate the plugin.
sections.faq:
How do I display my news?

After activating WP Top News, create your news items from the News section in your WordPress dashboard.

Then add the shortcode to any page or post.

For example:

[wtn_news layout=”grid”]

or:

[wtn_news layout=”list”]

Can I display news by category?

Yes. You can display news from a specific category using the category shortcode option.

Example:

[wtn_news layout=”list” category=”sports”]

Can I use different layouts on different pages?

Yes. You can use shortcode options to display different layouts and configurations on different pages.

For example, you can use a Grid layout on one page and a List or another Pro layout on another page.

Is WP Top News responsive?

Yes. WP Top News layouts are designed to work across desktop, tablet and mobile devices.

Does WP Top News support RTL languages?

Yes. RTL support is included.

Do I need coding knowledge?

No. WP Top News is designed to be easy to use. You can create and display news using the WordPress dashboard and shortcode.

Is a Pro version available?

Yes. WP Top News Pro adds advanced layouts and customization features including Editorial Grid, Modern List, Breaking News Ticker, Homepage Hero, Featured News Slider and RSS Feed Display.

View Pro Features

Can I display RSS feeds?

Yes. RSS Feed Display is available in the Pro version.

Can I use WP Top News to build a news website?

Yes. WP Top News is designed to help you create news sections, magazine-style layouts and complete news portal experiences using your own WordPress news content.
